parsed.explanation: The division sits under a hostile parent regime that cannot be discounted: federal passport/visa policy allows refusal where documents cast doubt on sex and consideration of fraud ineligibility, federal facilities are directed to birth-sex use, and federal custody abuses are documented. Those are traveller-facing universal exposures. The division materially mitigates them: it is listed in the most-protective tier, bans gender-identity discrimination in public accommodations including hotels, requires gender-neutral single-user bathrooms, has gender-identity hate-crime penalties, and has shield laws enforceable against out-of-state action for travellers seeking care. No state bathroom ban is documented. Mitigation is limited because no enforcement data for public-accommodations or hate-crime complaints is sourced, national litigation and public hostility remain unresolved, and federal border/facility exposure applies regardless of state law.
